main.summary: Provides immutable published-content snapshots for readable segmented transfer sessions.

method.name: TryLoadSnapshot
method.summary: Attempts to load a published-content snapshot for the specified item identifier and item instance token.
method.returns: Published snapshot when available; otherwise null.

method.name: OpenReadRange
method.summary: Opens a readable stream for a specific published-content byte range.
method.returns: Readable payload stream when available; otherwise null.
